source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie, Thanks for this, I will review and get back to you asap with feedback.

Separately I have been looking into coding your designs for the live website. I want to do this in Claude (chat) which I use for most of my work. I uploaded your landing page and explored various approaches. The conclusion we (forgive the anthropomorphism) came to was to code the site in plain HTML plus Tailwind and drop Astro, as it brings no benefits in our context.

We also thought it would be a good idea to outline approaches that would make the coding process easier and the results more faithful to your designs. I have attached a couple of brief documents to that effect. These are just drafts for discussion. Let us ;-) know what you think. Mark

value_updates.handoff_objective: Make implementation easier and more faithful to the designs.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Here is a zip of the landing page! It includes all the styling for desktop, tablet, and mobile views. Let me know if it looks good

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Hope you had a good weekend. I've been working on your landing page design and have loaded it up on S3 behind CloudFront. The URL is <https://d2oh0ug4dgao74.cloudfront.net>. I've added some more copy and made a few minor tweaks. I think it's really shaping up. Let me know what you think.

I also implemented tenant dashboard sign-in which works but needs Actia branding. I'm half way through the sign-up wizard and will add it when it's fully working. Can I send you an invite for an Actia login so you can check these out. Let me know the email address to use or if you want me to create an <http://actia.ai|actia.ai> email for you.

I agree with your decision to remove navigation from the header. I'll add links in the footer over time, which seems to be the current trend. I captured a few footers to see what people were doing.

Best,
Mark

execution.observed_behavior: Client reports successfully loading the handed-off landing-page design onto S3 behind CloudFront.
